contradicting_evidence: Positive BTC settled flows and current spot resilience leave a durable recovery branch open; the evidence does not establish a market-wide breakdown.
ETH currently outperforms BTC over both the supplied hour and 24-hour window, challenging a simple extrapolation of persistent ETH-relative weakness.
Positive large-alt participation could broaden, although persistence and wider-universe coverage are not established.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Expect an uneven week in which recovery attempts remain vulnerable to retests. BTC has more direct flow support than ETH, while smaller-alt participation remains less convincing. Downside sensitivity is elevated, but neither a sustained contraction nor broad recovery is sufficiently established for a one-way forecast.
falsification_conditions: Durable BTC and ETH gains accompanied by sustained ETH/BTC strength, broader median participation and improving settled ETH flows would invalidate the retest-sensitive outlook toward recovery.
Persistent BTC weakness together with deteriorating ETH/BTC, breadth and settled flows would invalidate the mixed outlook toward contraction.
missing_evidence: A sustained multi-session trajectory for prices, ETH/BTC, breadth and capitalization participation.
Further settled ETF sessions establishing whether BTC support and ETH outflows persist or reverse.
Evidence that stablecoin supply contraction stabilizes and that available liquidity is deployed.
Current catalyst and macro developments relevant to the coming week.
supporting_evidence: Stablecoin supply declined approximately 0.25% over one day, 0.73% over seven days and 1.21% over 30 days; this limits evidence of an expanding liquidity backdrop without determining price direction.
Settled ETF demand is divergent: BTC received $110.3 million while ETH lost $88.6 million in the latest final session.
Only 35 of 100 breadth constituents outperformed BTC and 24 outperformed ETH; current positive market breadth is not equivalent to broad relative-strength transmission.
The small-alt proxy was approximately flat with fewer than half advancing, while the mid-alt mean substantially exceeded its median.
The structural prior documents an unsuccessful earlier rebound and divergent multi-session flows. This supports retest awareness but does not independently determine the forecast.
